name: Ritalinic acid
summary: Ritalinic acid is a substituted phenethylamine and an inactive major metabolite of the psychostimulant drugs methylphenidate, dexmethylphenidate and ethylphenidate. When administered orally, methylphenidate is extensively metabolized in the liver by hydrolysis of the ester group yielding ritalinic acid. The hydrolysis was found to be catalyzed by carboxylesterase 1 (CES1).

uses.text: Ritalinic acid is used as an intermediate in the synthesis of methylphenidate and its analogues, such as ethylphenidate and isopropylphenidate.

summaryZh: 利太林酸（英語：Ritalinic acid）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C13H17NO2，屬於苯乙胺衍生物，是許多興奮劑，如哌甲酯、哌乙酯的主要無活性代謝產物。

pharmacology.en: It is inactive. It does not block the dopamine or noradrenaline transporters as methylphenidate does.
pharmacology.zh: 它沒有活性，不像派醋甲酯那樣會阻斷多巴胺或正腎上腺素轉運蛋白。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它没有活性，不像派醋甲酯那样会阻断多巴胺或正肾上腺素转运蛋白。

fact.en: Ritalinic acid is what methylphenidate becomes in the body once an enzyme cuts off its methyl ester. Most of a dose ends up as this inactive acid, which is what drug tests usually look for.
fact.zh: 利太林酸是派醋甲酯在體內被酵素切掉甲酯後的產物。大部分的藥量最後都變成這種沒有活性的酸，藥物檢驗通常就是檢測它。
fact.zhHans: 利太林酸是派醋甲酯在体内被酵素切掉甲酯后的产物。大部分的药量最后都变成这种没有活性的酸，药物检验通常就是检测它。
